diffs.diff: pin count: part has 9 (VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA DO CS I1 I2), datasheet reading has 14 (VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA DO CS I1 I2 SCX SDX CS DO GND)
diffs.evidence: The Adafruit #4438 pinout page lists the main header pins Vin, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, DO, CS, INT1, INT2, and separately 'SCX, SDX, Aux CS, DO (Top) - Pins for advanced users to connect the LSM6DSOX ... to another sensor.' The extra 5 pins in the second reading (SCX SDX CS DO GND) are that separate auxiliary sensor-hub header. The model's description says it models the 9-pin main header only, with the 5-pin auxiliary header not modelled, and its footprint is PinHeader_1x09. The 9 modelled pins match the main header exactly.

diffs.diff: acceleration_mg: datasheet reading gives 0.061 per count, the part's model has 0.003906, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.000061, 0.000061, 0.000061
diffs.evidence: Datasheet Table 2: 'LA_So Linear acceleration sensitivity FS = ±2 g 0.061 mg/LSB'. The model's accel measures (0x28/0x2A/0x2C) use 6.1e-05 g/LSB, which is the same value as 0.061 mg/LSB expressed in g. The driver also uses 0.061e-3 g/LSB at ±2 g. The other listed scales belong to the temperature channel (0.003906 = 1/256 °C/LSB) and the gyro channels (0.00875 dps/LSB).

diffs.diff: angular_rate_mdps: datasheet reading gives 8.75 per count, the part's model has 0.003906, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.000061, 0.000061, 0.000061
diffs.evidence: Datasheet Table 2: 'G_So Angular rate sensitivity FS = ±250 dps 8.75 mdps/LSB'. The model's gyro measures (0x22/0x24/0x26) use 0.00875 dps/LSB, which is the same value as 8.75 mdps/LSB expressed in dps, at the ±250 dps range the driver configures (CTRL2_G = 0x40). The other listed scales belong to the temperature and accelerometer channels.
